title: Integrar barrera de contención con fixture de generación fija
mission: Verify the end-to-end integration between explicit contention barriers and fixed-generation ownership semantics. A barrier-enabled generation-fixed fixture must rendezvous before PIN, RELEASE all valid entrants onto the same declared generation, record normal loser collisions, resolve fixed_generation_attention when the declared evidence threshold is satisfied, and never manufacture ordinary G+1 ownership. Ordinary non-barrier and retry-safe jobs must retain their existing behavior.
definition_of_done: A barrier-enabled fixed-generation fixture exposes a timing-only pre-PIN barrier action and does not expose PORTFOLIO_PIN_CREATE before valid RELEASE.
After RELEASE, distinct entrants target the same declared fixed generation and exactly one PIN authority wins; losers create durable collision evidence and no execution authority.
When the fixed acceptance threshold is reached, fixed_generation_attention resolves without exposing G+1 ordinary recovery for that fixture.
Barrier timeout produces no PIN attempt and no false fixed-generation completion.
Ordinary jobs without barrier metadata remain direct-to-PIN, and ordinary retry-safe jobs preserve next-generation recovery.
Regression coverage is generic and metadata-driven; no fixture job-id blacklist is introduced.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.
